proposal.observation: On the unchanged incumbent, all 10 expected ring instances are present, but correspondence_f1@15 is only 0.3224. Round 1 left the depth map unchanged, moved several prompt midpoints, reduced the visible midpoint set from eight to seven while preserving the assume and positive-slope anchors, and lowered correspondence_f1@15 by 0.04931. This shows that changing detection alone perturbed prompt placement without improving the underlying joint evidence.
proposal.rule: When a bounded detection-only overlay degrades correspondence while depth structure is unchanged, do not continue isolated Hough tuning. Instead, test one coordinated non-unfolding setting that jointly conditions denoising and enhancement, applies the corresponding detector configuration, and aligns the SAM processing bound.

proposal.rationale: This is the complete stage-2-through-stage-5 portion of the staggered development overlay whose measured joint response improved proxy score from 0.741 to 0.744 while preserving ring count and reducing depth_nan_ratio. Round 1 established that its detection portion alone is harmful on subset 1-5, so the proposal tests the coordinated setting rather than assigning causality to any individual parameter. Unfolding is omitted because stage1_unlocked is false, and every value is inside the packet bounds.
